items.label: ENERGY SAVING
items.value: LED units output 32 W, 3500 Lumen, 5000 K brightness (day light white), equivalent to 150 W halogen light. Also save your electricity bill by up to 88%

items.label: MOTION ACTIVATE
items.value: The wide sensing angle of 180 degrees detects motion up to 0 ft-69 ft away, detecting motion more accurately with its sensitive motion sensor. The adjustable timer can be set for tests, 1, 3 or 10 minutes

items.label: 4 LIGHTING MODES
items.value: Test Mode, Security Mode, Dusk to Dawn Mode and Manual Override Mode. Manual override mode allows light to operate constantly for selected period of time (Flip the wall switch OFF-ON-OFF-ON within 3 seconds). More choices can meet different demand for each customer

items.label: METAL AND ROTATABLE DESIGN
items.value: Adjustable heads provide a customizable coverage area. Aluminum material, IP65 waterproof. Product size: 9.21in x 6.5in ( 154mm x 234mm). Works better with a 4.13" junction box

items.label: HIGH-QUALITY SERVICE
items.value: We provide 7*24 h after-sales service. Contact us if any issue arises
